div.head: Duns 3
div.ab: Gif bad genumen sy on mannes orfe for oðres mannes ðingum, ðonne begyte ða bade ham se, ðe heo fore genumen sy, oððe of his agenum ðone gehalde, ðe þæt orf age:
Si namum capiatur de alicuius pecunia pro alterius causa, perquirat ille namum, pro quo captum est, uel de suo proprio restituat ei, cuius pecunia capta est.

(Von Pfändern. lq) Wenn ein Pfand an jemandes Vieh fortgenommen worden ist, um [der Schuld] eines anderen Mannes willen [aus demselben Stamme], dann schaffe dieser, wegen dessen es fortgenommen worden ist, jenes Pfand heim oder befriedige aus seinem Eigenen jenen, dem das [abgepfändete] Vieh gehört:

(Of distraints. lq) If a distraint has been taken from someone's cattle on account of [the debt of] another man [of the same people], then let the one on whose account it was taken get that distraint back home, or satisfy out of his own [property] the one who owns the [distrained] cattle:

If a pledge of one’s cattle is taken, for another man’s cause [debt], then let him [on whose behalf the pledge was given] restore the property, or repay the amount lost by the man whose pledge was accepted [and taken].
